tower.partner.people.hintSome: {n, plural, one {# in it} other {# in it}}
tower.partner.people.lede: The partner’s own people sign in to the Partner app (seebuyget.com/partner/) with their phone and their own PIN, and read live what the partner owes its shops, hubs and drivers. Add them by the number they sign in with; take somebody out here, and from their next tap they read nothing more.
tower.partner.people.name: Their name
tower.partner.pay.title: Payment account
tower.partner.pay.lede: The partner’s money goes through its own account in our payment hub: a payment prompt on the payer’s phone, and the provider’s answer. For now it runs on the stand-in, with test money: no real money moves, and no parcel is paid through it yet.
tower.partner.pay.holdsUnknown: What it holds is not known: the provider did not answer.
tower.partner.pay.ownLater: The partner’s own provider (telebirr, M-Pesa or Chapa) is added once the partner is chosen. Its keys are entered here and kept locked, and two of our staff switch it live.
tower.partner.pay.tryHint: A payment prompt to a phone, on test money. The stand-in answers after a few seconds: paid, or declined for a number ending in 0000. A number ending in 9999 never answers.
tower.partner.pay.why.unreachable: the provider could not be reached
tower.partner.pay.feeLede: A percentage of every parcel’s payment into the partner’s account, counted as it is paid. The partner owes it; it is a loan until a company of ours can invoice it.
tower.partner.pay.feeNow: {pct}% of every payment, set by {by} on {at}.
tower.partner.pay.totals: Paid in {paidIn} · given back {givenBack} · paid out {paidOut}

tower.partner.checks.say.payoutNewNumber: Paid {amount} on {day} to a payout number changed on {changedOn}.
tower.partner.checks.say.paidBeyondOwed: Paid {amount} in all, where the steps owed come to {owed}.
tower.partner.pay.payoutsLede: Once a day, each shop, hub and driver it owes is paid what it is owed, from this account, to the number it set and confirmed. A payout that cannot go waits, and is tried again every hour.
tower.partner.pay.payoutsSum: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing waits} one {# waits} other {# wait}}: {amount}. Paid so far: {paid}.

tower.partner.pay.wait.unreachable: the provider has not answered yet
tower.amounts.math: A parcel taken in at the counter brings in {price}. Sorting it at a hub still at its starting fee, shelving and handing it over pay out at least {out} of that — more where a shop’s own fee is more.
tower.amounts.mathOver: A parcel taken in at the counter brings in {price}, and sorting it at a hub still at its starting fee, shelving and handing it over pay out {out}: more than it brings in. Check which box each figure is in.
tower.amounts.priceNeeded: A parcel has to cost something: its price is also the float a shop needs to take one in.
tower.amounts.saved: Saved. Every step done from now on uses these figures.
tower.topupfee.title: What it costs to put money in
tower.topupfee.hint: A flat charge on a top-up below the threshold, and nothing at or above it. Flat because what it recovers is a cost per PAYMENT, not per shilling — a percentage would charge twice as much for a top-up that costs us the same to carry. Free above the threshold so it is never friction for a shop that has run dry mid-morning. The shop is credited the full amount and charged separately, and both lines show on its register.
tower.topupfee.none: No fee. Shops and stores in this country top up for nothing, and neither app shows a charge.
tower.topupfee.current: Now: {charge} on anything under {freeAbove}. {freeAbove} or more is free.
tower.topupfee.fold.none: No fee — topping up costs nothing
tower.topupfee.clearHint: Empty both boxes and save to charge nothing at all. That is not the same as a fee of zero, which is refused — a charge of nothing still puts a fee on a shopkeeper’s screen.
tower.topupfee.needsBoth: Set both, or neither. A threshold with no charge behind it charges nobody, and a charge with no threshold is one nobody can avoid by topping up more.
tower.topupfee.chargeTooLow: A charge has to be more than nothing. To charge nothing, empty both boxes instead.
tower.topupfee.thresholdTooLow: The threshold has to be more than nothing, or the fee can never be avoided.
tower.topupfee.tooSteep: That is a fifth of the threshold or more, which is a tariff on being short rather than a payment cost. The most this threshold allows is {max}.
tower.topupfee.saved: Saved. Every shop and store in this country sees the charge on its top-up sheet before it pays.
tower.topupfee.removed: Removed. Topping up costs nothing here, and neither app shows a fee.
tower.impact.title: What each rate actually did
tower.impact.hint: Per spell, in time order — a rate raised and lowered again is two periods to compare
tower.impact.emptyBody: No shipment has been sold under a rate here, so there is nothing to compare. This fills itself in as work goes through.
tower.impact.fold: {n, plural, one {# period so far} other {# periods to compare}}
tower.impact.unpriced: {n} more carried no margin at all — walk-up cash, which is priced by a different product and would only dilute the rates it was never sold at.
tower.companies.title: The companies, side by side
tower.companies.lede: Each one is a separate company with its own currency, its own tax registration and its own books. This is the only place they can be read against each other.
tower.companies.caveat: These companies settle in different currencies, and a total across them would be a number that is wrong in a way nobody can see. Each column stays in its own money.
tower.companies.groupCharges: The mother company charges nothing: it is the merchant of record nowhere and is never a party to a customer transaction. It earns its licence fee from the sisters.
tower.companies.noPricing: Could not read what this company charges.
tower.companies.noBooks: Could not read this company’s books. Shown as missing rather than as zero — a zero balance and an unanswered question look identical and mean opposite things.
tower.companies.groupBooks: It settles in no currency of its own, so there is nothing to hold against what it owes — coverage is a question only a trading company can be asked. Its books still have to balance, and they do.
tower.companies.warnings: {n, plural, one {# warning — see its record} other {# warnings — see its record}}
tower.companies.createLede: A company of ours or a local partner starts as a draft, and a draft can do nothing. It is switched on only when its record is complete, its papers are verified by a second person, and two people approve its country up to it.

tower.company.title: Company record
tower.company.ledeOwn: Your company’s record is yours to keep. Its legal details, addresses, owners, tax numbers and what the country requires: change and save. A licence, an insurance policy, a bank account or who may sign changes one at a time, together with the paper behind it, and counts from that moment. Your fellow administrators, and the company above yours, are emailed each such change.
tower.company.ledeDraft: Your company is not switched on yet. Until it is, SeeBuyGet staff enter its record and a second person verifies each paper. Put your papers on record under Papers. Once it is switched on, the record is yours to keep.
tower.company.ledeTheirs: This company is switched on and keeps its own record: its administrators change it, each licence, policy, bank account and signatory together with the paper behind it. You read it.
tower.company.lede: Everything that makes a company real — its legal form, registration, the people who may sign, its owners, tax numbers, bank, licences, insurance and the papers behind them. Entered here, from the network side, before its country is switched on.
tower.company.groupNoRecord: The group keeps no operating record here — it is a party to nothing.
tower.company.readyOn: Two members of staff switched this company on, from its record and its papers. That check is not made again: from here the company keeps its own record, and each paper it puts on record counts.

tower.paperReport.title: Reported papers
tower.paperReport.lede: Somebody signed in and connected to a company has said that one of its papers is not right, and attached what shows it. The paper keeps counting while you look. One of you may dismiss a report, with the reason. Striking the paper takes two of you — one proposes, a second approves — and not before the company has answered or its seven days are up.

tower.paperReport.cat.expired: It has run out, or been withdrawn

tower.paperReport.fact.countsYes: Yes: a report changes nothing by itself
tower.paperReport.saidHint: The company reads the words, never the name or what was attached.
tower.paperReport.notAnswered: It has not answered. It may until {when}.
tower.paperReport.decideHint: Dismissing leaves everything as it is, and one of you can. Striking the paper puts back what it changed — a struck renewal, and the previous date counts again — and takes two of you.
tower.paperReport.waitToStrike: A strike cannot be proposed yet: the company has until {when} to answer, and is heard first. A dismissal does not wait.
tower.paperReport.strikeWhy: Why this paper should be struck
tower.paperReport.strikeWhyHint: What you checked and what it showed. The second member of staff approves on the strength of it, and the company reads it.
tower.paperReport.approveLede: {who} proposes to strike this paper: “{reason}” If you approve, the paper stops counting now and what it changed is put back.
tower.paperReport.otherApproves: You proposed to strike it: “{reason}” A second member of staff approves; it cannot be you.
tower.paperReport.sent: Reported. The paper keeps counting; the company is told what you said, not who said it, and has seven days to answer.
tower.paperReport.answerSent: Your answer is with SeeBuyGet staff. The paper keeps counting until they decide.
tower.paperReport.needNote: Say what is wrong with it.
tower.paperReport.needEvidence: Attach what shows it: a screenshot or a photograph.
tower.paperReport.needAnswer: Say what is right about it.
tower.paperReport.form.reportHint: Say what is wrong with this paper and attach what shows it — a screenshot of the issuer’s register, a photograph, a letter. Nothing changes by reporting: the paper keeps counting, the company is told what you said (not who said it) and may answer, and then SeeBuyGet staff decide.
tower.paperReport.form.answerHint: Say what is right about this paper, and attach what shows it if you can. If the report is right, put the right paper on record with “Change, with its paper” instead.
